description: Probe search, clearing and claim payouts, from the Solidity libraries (test/clearing.test.ts; UPDATE_VECTORS=1 rewrites this file). `sums1` and `sums2` are the revealed sums of the two rounds (0 at levels that were not revealed). `claims` give the immediate payout of a claim with the comparison `cmp`; a capped claim with cmp 1 pays nothing there (it registers and is filled by `marginalFills`).
